description: This Java interface defines the contract for a DefinitionIdentifier, representing a fully qualified identifier with namespace, name, and version components within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace part of the identifier.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name part of the identifier.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version part of the identifier.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the identifier in the format 'namespace:name:version'.
